title: Avril Lavigne Welcomes First Baby, Shares Photo of Daughter
text:
Avril Lavigne Welcomes First Baby, Shares Photo of Daughter 
 News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Avril Lavigne Welcomes First Baby
 Avril Lavigne shared she has welcomed her first child, sharing a glimpse at her baby girl:  “Our mini f--king princess has arrived.”
 By Kisha Forde Nov 13, 2026 4:44 PM | Updated 44 minutes ago Tags Babies Avril Lavigne Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Avril Lavigne’s Role in Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce’s Wedding Revealed Avril Lavigne is raising a sk8er girl.
 The "Sk8er Boi" musician recently shared a major glimpse into her private world, confirming she is now a mom after welcoming her first child, a baby girl.
 "Our mini f--king princess," she captioned a Nov. 13 Instagram post featuring photos of her holding her daughter, three pairs of vans as well as her hand and another holding their baby's finger, "has arrived.”
 Prior to expanding her family, over the years, Lavigne, 42—who hasn't shared details about the identity of her baby's father—has kept her personal life close to the vest.
 Before tying the knot with now-ex Chad Kroeger , she was married to Sum 41 alum Deryck Whibley for three years until 2009, ending their relationship on amicable terms.
 "Deryck and I have been together for 6-and-a-half years,” she wrote on her website at the time. “We have been friends since I was 17, started dating when I was 19, and married when I was 21. I am grateful for our time together, and I am grateful and blessed for our remaining friendship."
 photos Looking Back on Avril Lavigne's Relationship History In fact, their breakup just wasn’t complicated.
 "I admire Deryck and have a great amount of respect for him,” she continued. “He is the most amazing person I know and I love him with all my heart. Deryck and I are separating and moving forward on a positive note.”
 Anthony Harvey/Shutterstock And when she met Kroger in 2012, she ultimately decided that she wanted to be more than just his girlfriend, with the couple exchanging vows just a year later. However, by 2015, her relationship with the  Nickelback  singer met a different ending.
 "It is with [a] heavy heart that Chad and I announce our separation today,” she wrote on social media at the time. “Through not only the marriage, but the music as well, we've created many unforgettable moments. We are still, and forever will be, the best of friends, and will always care deeply for each other. To all our family, friends and fans, thank you sincerely for the support."
 Since then, Lavigne has been linked to Brody Jenner , Mod Sun and most recently in 2023, Tyga . And though she’s rarely shared insight into her personal life, the “Complicated” singer has opened up about taking a step back from the spotlight entirely.
 "I spent the last few years at home sick fighting Lyme Disease,” she wrote on her personal website in 2018. “Those were the worst years of my life as I went through both physical and emotional battles. I was able to turn that fight into music I'm really proud of. I wrote songs in my bed and on the couch and recorded there mostly as well. Words and lyrics that were so true to my experience came pouring out of me effortlessly. Truly... by keeping my spirits up, having goals to reach and a purpose to live for, my music helped to heal me and keep me alive."
 "I'm taking my life back into my own hands and doing what it is I know I am meant to be doing in this life time,” she added. “Making music.”
 For a look at all the celebs who have had babies rock their worlds this year, keep reading...
 Instagram/Kaley Cuoco Kaley Cuoco & Tom Pelphrey
 The Big Bang Theory alum gave birth to her second baby , a girl named Philomena Carmine Bobby Pelphrey , with the Task actor on Oct. 12. 
 "There are no words to describe this feeling once again. What a blessing," Cuoco—who's also mom to daughter Matilda — shared on instagram . "We are so grateful for the crazy wild up and down journey that brought us to our little Philo! Family officially complete."
 Monique Cook/Instagram Charvarius Ward & Monique Cook
 The Indianapolis Colts cornerback and his fiancée Monique Cook shared that they welcomed their third baby , a boy named Chosen Mani Ward , on Sept. 28.
 The two are already parents to son Charvarius Ward Jr. as well as daughter Amani Joy , who died in 2024 at 23 months.
 Emma McIntyre/Getty Images for GQ Jesse Williams & Alejandra Onieva
 The  Grey's Anatomy  alum confirmed the arrival of his baby with the Spanish actress in a hilarious video recreating Spike Lee 's 1989 movie  Do The Right Thing . 
 Arnold Jerocki/GC Images Dylan Sprouse & Barbara Palvin
 Life got sweeter for the Disney Channel alum and the Victoria's Secret model after she gave birth to their first child —a baby girl—in early September.
 Hinting at their daughter's birth date, the couple wrote on Instagram, " We took Labor Day literally this year." 
 Kevin Winter/Getty Images Taylor Lautner & Tay Lautner
 Hold on tight, spider monkey—because the Twilight alum and his wife welcomed their first baby together on Sept. 16.
 And yes, the couple did make a reference to their identical names when choosing a moniker for their new daughter Lennon Taylor Lautner .
 Jerod Harris/Getty Images for Netflix Millie Bobby Brown & Jake Bongiovi
 Over one year after adopting their daughter, the Stranger Things star and the Sweethearts actor added a baby boy to their family, writing on Instagram in September 2026, "hi little guy!"
 Justin Palmer/Getty Images Lena Dunham & Luis Felber
 The Girls actress shared on Sept. 16 that the pair welcomed their first child , a daughter, via surrogate.
 “Hello. I’m your mama," she recalled telling her baby in a Vogue essay. "You … you look nothing like I thought you would, but exactly right. We’ve been waiting for you, do you know that? It was so nice of you to come.”
 Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for The Recording Academy Lady Gaga & Michael Polansky
 On Sept. 11, multiple outlets reported that the "Born This Way" singer and her fiancé of over two years had welcomed their first baby together .
 A birth certificate obtained by E! News later revealed that their child—a girl named Rose Bean Polansky —was born on June 9 in Los Angeles.
 Jeremiah Duggar & Hannah Duggar
 You can count on the Duggars to expand their brood. The 19 Kids & Counting  alum and his wife announced the arrival of their fourth baby on Aug. 7, writing on Instagram , "Life feels busier than ever, yet we find ourselves trying to slow down to just soak in these days with our littles. And we wouldn’t have it any other way!"
 Lionel Hahn/Getty Images Sean Ono Lennon & Charlotte Kemp Muhl 
 John Lennon and Yoko Ono 's son announced that he and his partner welcomed a baby boy in a Sept. 1 social media post . 
 "Okay so…Charlotte and I would like to announce that [we] have indeed created a Human Bean!"  Ono Lennon wrote. "His name is, Aurelius ! Thank you!"
 Chelsea Manzo/Instagram Albie Manzo & Chelsea Manzo
 The Real Housewives of New Jersey alum Caroline Manzo 's son welcomed his second child with his wife, who captioned photos of their newborn baby boy on Aug. 4, "Welcome to the world our sweet Theodore ."
 Photo by Max Mumby/Indigo/Getty Images Princess Eugenie & Jack Brooksbank
 The youngest daughter of Prince Andrew and Sarah Ferguson  gave birth to her third child —a baby girl—on Aug. 3 at a hospital in Lisbon, Portugal.
 "The baby was born weighing 6 pounds 9 ounces,"  a statement read on the royal family’s official  Instagram page, adding that King Charles III and Queen Camilla "were delighted to be informed of the news.”
 Jenna Compono/Instagram Jenna Compono & Zach Nichols 
 The  Challenge alums announced that they had welcomed their fifth baby together Aug. 2, less than a year after having their daughter  Francesca. 
 "With a 2-week early grand entrance, we'd like to welcome  Vincent John  into the world," Compono wrote  on Instagram Aug. 3 . "What originally was a checkup due to cramping led to a medically necessary induction due to low fluid (Oligo). Love you to bunches, my little Vinny boy." 
 Amy Sussman/Getty Images Sebastian Stan & Annabelle Wallis
 The Marvel star and the Peaky Blinders actress welcomed their first baby together in July 2026, mulitple outlets reported. 
 Photo by Candice Ward/Getty Images for Netflix Marc Anthony & Nadia Ferreira
 The "I Need to Know" singer became a dad of eight when his wife gave birth to their daughter Myla , sharing in a July 21 that their family is "over the moon."
 “What a great blessing to be able to share with you the arrival of our precious MYLA,” the couple wrote in a joint statement. “You can't imagine the happiness we have at home."
 Photo by Phillip Faraone/Getty Images for Belvedere Vodka Becca Tobin & Zach Martin
 On an episode of her LadyGang podcast, the Glee alum announced that her seond baby—a daughter named Meyer June Martin —"decided to make an early entrance into the world."
 "She was supposed to be born August 26, and she was born July 19," Tobin revealed, explaining how her surrogate had to induce labor due to preeclampsia. "The doctor was like, 'You know what? At this point, the baby is cooked pretty nicely.'"
 Jarah Mariano/Instagram Milo Ventimiglia & Jarah Mariano 
 This is...a family of five. After announcing their pregnancy in January, the couple confirmed the arrival of their baby boy in July. 
 "These last couple of weeks have been chaos, but in the best possible way," Mariano wrote in an Instagram post . "Welcome back home Rock-Anthony Makoa Ventimiglia. Can’t wait for all of the adventures ahead with our family of 5!"
 Eric Charbonneau/Getty Images for Warner Bros. Luke Wilson & Kendall Yates
 The couple—who have been dating since at least 2023—confirmed they welcomed a baby together, with the actor jokingly telling E! News at the premiere of The Hawk , "It's nice to be out before I go back to work on my shift."
 Campbell Puckett/Instagram Campbell Puckett & Jett Puckett
 The couple announced they'd welcomed their baby on July 1 after Campbell's water broke early.
 "Feels like heaven on earth,” she captioned a July 1 video  of her cradling the newborn. "Baby is here and healthy.”
 Photo by Mat Hayward/Getty Images for The Players Alliance Zack Goytowski & Bliss Poureetezadi-Goytowski
 Love is unique—just ask the parents of baby boy  Polaris J ³ ohn Pax Goytowski .
 Yes, the Love Is Blind couple gave their son what they described as a "three-dimensional name represented in two-dimensional space" when he was born on June 29.
 The reveal of the unconventional moniker—an homage to three J-named family members—comes two years after the birth of their daughter Galileo Terri Rayne Goytowski .
 Rodin Eckenroth/Getty Images for Hallmark Ben Rosenbaum & Erin Krakow
 The  When Calls the Heart costars confirmed that they welcomed a baby girl in April, 10 months after they secretly wed in June 2025. 
 "Our daughter has been the greatest gift,” they told People in an interview published June 23, “and we are loving getting to know her better with each passing day."
 Danielle Olivera/Eoin Heavey/Instagram Danielle Olivera & Eoin Heavey
 The  Summer House alum and her boyfriend welcomed their first baby together, Aidan Santos Heavey , on June 21, 10 weeks earlier than expected.
 "He's heading to summer camp at NICU for the first 2/3 months in this world, but mom and dad can't wait to bring him home hopefully soon," Heavey wrote on Instagram. "Dad was a nervous, terrified, sobbing mess but couldn't ask for a better first Father's Day."
 Lindsay Arnold/Instagram Lindsay Arnold & Sam Cusick
 On June 11, the Dancing With the Stars alum announced she had given birth to her third child, a son named Hayes Duff Cusick , with her husband of 10 years.
 "Baby boy is here," she captioned Instagram photos of herself holding the newborn in the hospital after her C-section, "and we are so grateful and so in love."
 Brandon Barash/Instagram Brandon Barash & Isabella Devoto
 The Days of Our Lives alum and his wife welcomed their second baby together—a boy named Sebastian Antonio Barash —on June 5. 
 "House is full," Barash—who also shares son Joaquin with Devoto and daughter Harper with ex-wife Kirsten Storms — wrote on Instagram . "Hearts fuller."
 Molly-Mae Hague/Instagram Molly-Mae Hague & Tommy Fury
 A baby has entered the villa! The Love Island UK couple announced on June 4 that they had welcomed their second baby together —a boy.
 Valerie Terranova/WireImage Scott Hoying & Mark Manio Hoying
 The Pentatonix member and his husband welcomed a baby girl named Birde James Hoying via surrogate on June 3. 
 "The process of us having a child took four or five years," Hoying told People in an interview published June 23. "It's been a long time coming and just looking at her, I started crying because it was just such a beautiful thing that I feel really, really lucky."
 Prince Williams/WireImage; Aaron J. Thornton/WireImage Latto & 21 Savage
 The "Big Mama" rapper welcomed her first baby , a girl, with the "Bank Account" artist. 
 "There were tears and anxiety was through the roof," she noted about her pregnancy in an Apple Music interview published May 29. "It's what I wanted but I was just like, 'Wait, this real life, like am I really ready?' But ultimately, obviously had her and I'm glad I made the decision to do it."
 Madeleine White/Instagram Madeleine White & Andrew Fedyk
 The influencer and DJ welcomed baby girl Juliette July Fedyk on June 1, sharing that she was born early at 33 weeks.
 "Suddenly the world just got a whole lot brighter," Madeleine posted to Instagram June 2. "06.01.2026 4lbs and 17.2 inches. We love you so much and are so proud to be your parents x."
 Alex Weaver/Instagram Stephen Colletti & Alex Weaver
 The Laguna Beach alum and the NASCAR reporter announced the arrival of their first baby, Rhodes August Colletti , on Instagram May 14.
 Jesse Grant/Getty Images for Paramount+ Candice King & Steven Krueger
 The Originals couple welcomed their first baby together —a son named Arlo Dominic Krueger —on May 3.   King is also mom to two daughters with ex-husband Joe King .
